Same disagreement as the bklg ruling, which stands. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; i1040gi p. 91, Line 8c, and p4681 p. 4, "you must report canceled debt as gross income on your tax return unless one of the exceptions or exclusions described later applies". Both give zero when no debt was canceled and the canceled nonbusiness debt otherwise; the project floors s1.cod_amount at zero, which cannot change a nonnegative amount, as ruled before on this line. Re-reviewed because s1.cod_amount, which this line reads, was reworded (the sentence on a debt both spouses owed is now a conditional one, "On a joint return, count a debt both spouses owed once, even if each received a Form 1099-C for the whole amount"), and s1.cod_unsupported with it; wording only, no expression changed. The disagreement is the one ruled before on this line, in the words above: the candidate's expression and the project's are both unchanged from that ruling. executable-triage-v2 (`.transcription/triage/2025/s1.json`, pass 6eb0adfaa652; 1,767 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 646 partial records): 2,912 of 2,913 comparisons agree; the one difference is a candidate-unknown on an incomplete record; no completed-return difference. The project line is retained.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 93, Line 16: "If you were self-employed or a partner, you may be able to take this deduction". Partnership and other Schedule E or K-1 income is refused by scope.schedule1, so within scope only a person with a Schedule C can have the deduction; the project asks person.plan only then (person.s16, guarded by person.has_sc). The candidate sums person.plan_deduction for every person, asking plan questions of people with no self-employment income and reaching the SEP and SIMPLE excess screens for them. executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/s1.json`, written by triage.py this round; 1,565 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 610 partial records from 40 bases; 2,675 comparisons): 1,191 agree; 1,337 candidate-unknown, 147 candidate-refuses (on completed returns: 51 candidate-refuses, 53 candidate-unknown). The reply sums person.plan_deduction for every person, asking plan questions (and reaching the SEP and SIMPLE excess screens) for people with no Schedule C; the project asks person.plan only with a Schedule C (person.s16), project $0.00 in every witness (candidate-refuses classm.f8889.1.deepseek on sep_excess). Same reply and project as the bklg ruling, which stands. Project stands.
